svg.aria-label: CivicLens v1 overview: login window, role-based dashboard for Citizen, Moderator, Police, Journalist and Admin, the submit complaint form, the complaint status lifecycle and the SQL Server tables.

g.text: Multimedia complaint management for citizens and authorities (C# WinForms + SQL Server)
Report an issue and follow it to resolution.
See every complaint and assign it to Police or a Journalist.
Work your assigned complaints and update their status.
Review assigned complaints and mark them Covered.
Approve accounts, manage users, categories and locations.
The light has been off for a week and the
Every change is written to StatusHistory with the note, the person and the time.
